numbers.inspection_method:
Inspection box (shop-made; example dimensions, plausible, not measured): a hollow cast-iron 120 mm cube with 8 mm walls. Grind the base, the right side and the front face flat and square to each other within 0.003 mm per 100 mm. Cut two 32 x 24 mm clamp windows through the left wall, 8 to 40 mm behind the front face, at 38 to 62 and 83 to 107 mm above the base, and an 80 x 80 mm access window in the back wall. C stop bar: hardened ground steel, 40 x 12 x 12.2 mm, on the front face at its left end, projecting 12 mm forward with its underside 0.5 mm above the base; fix it with two M4 x 12 cap screws and two 4 x 16 mm dowels reamed through bar and wall together, then grind its top 12.70 mm above the base and parallel to it within 0.002 mm. Two light 3 in toolmaker's parallel clamps go through the left windows.

Equilibrate the part, the inspection box, the gauge pins and the gauge blocks on the granite plate at 20 ±1 °C.

Select the largest freely passing gauge pin for bore A and for the rod hole. Record pin A Ø ______ and rod pin Ø ______ (actual diameters marked on the pins).

Seat strap datum B against the box face with the A axis within 5 mm of the box's left edge and the hub clear above the box. Seat C on the fixed ground stop bar. Hold B with the two toolmaker's parallel clamps through the left windows, finger-light, without bending or clamping the free span.

How to read each pin: wring a gauge-block stack of known calibrated length near the pin's top, zero the 1 µm test indicator on the stack, then sweep the pin crown and read the deviation at the same height-gauge setting. Check that a higher contact reads positive. Pin-centre height = stack length + deviation − pin radius. The height gauge only carries the indicator; do not use its scale.

View 1, C face down on the stop bar (hub pin about 132.4 above the rod pin): read both pins within 2 mm of an accessible bore face. Record X = hub-centre height − rod-centre height ______.

Tip the whole box onto its marked ground RIGHT side without unclamping the part or losing C contact (rod pin about 15.8 below the hub pin). Read both pins the same way. Record Y1 = hub-centre height − rod-centre height ______.

Reseat check: gently press the non-rod tip toward the stop bar, release, and read both pins again at the same settings. Record Y2 ______. If Y2 and Y1 differ by more than 0.002, the seating did not repeat: reseat, then redo view 1 and this view. Use Y = Y2.

Lean check, in both views: read the hub pin at its accessible mouth and 10 mm farther out. Record view 1 ______ and view 2 ______. If either pair differs by more than 0.005, or B cannot seat without leaning the pin, the readings are not valid: reseat and repeat; if it persists, stop and report.

Result: position Ø = 2 × √((X − 132.391)² + (Y − 15.843)²), using the CAD nominals for this inspection set-up (not the milling X/Y). Record position Ø ______ and compare it with the drawing limit on the op row (RFS, no bonus).
